integrity: The universal proof is a standalone combinatorial argument. The included standard-library checker independently tests geodesic convexity, traces and finite extremal enumerations. Its finite checks do not substitute for the infinite-parameter proof. General Boolean-box private-coordinate characterization is preparatory and not claimed as new.
limitations: Classical VC dimension only. No Littlestone dimension, algorithmic sample complexity, or matroid-generalization theorem. Earlier subcube-range formulations may contain the extremal formulas; independent historical-priority audit is outstanding. One directly relevant 2022 full text was not accessible.
title: Exact maximal-shattering counts and a rank plateau for Johnson-graph convexity
